subject: Encord & Osaro - Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

Happy New Year! I was wondering if you'd be open to a quick virtual coffee
in the coming weeks? We're very familiar with Osaro, as we're seeing a lot
of momentum in the Physical AI space (working w/ Ambi Robotics, Pickle
Robot, Rapid Robotics, Archetype AI, Physical Intelligence etc.) , so keen
to trade notes & build a relationship. Not sure if your ML team has any
plans to reevaluate their data infra stack (annotation, curation, model
eval) this year? Either way it'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your
feedback on what we're building. I've included a short blurb of what we do
below.

Encord is an SF-based data development platform (raised a $30M Series B
last year) built to help computer vision & multimodal AI teams get better
models to market, faster. 150+ of the world's top AI teams are leveraging
Encord to:

   - Easily curate, manage, visualise & search their unstructured training
   data at scale
   - Build active learning workflows to analyse both raw & labelled data,
   identifying model blindspots & find rare edge case
   - Automate parts of their annotation process - typically seeing 6-10x
   throughput gain

subject: [YEAR] Claude roadmap
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

Congratulations on recently launching Octave - curious to understand how you're thinking about fine-tuning Anthropic's Claude models further to roll out new products this year?

Many of the Audio AI teams we work with were frustrated by the growing administrative QA burden of fine-tuning foundational models, often struggling to stay on top of feedback recorded in Google Docs, Sheets or Notion pages.

We built Encord as a multimodal data development platform, designed to support the fine-tuning / validation against foundation models at scale, enabling teams to accelerate their new product releases.

Open to learning more?

subject: We have an MSA with Fraunhofer | AI annotation, curation & evaluation
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

We have an MSA in place with Fraunhofer as we work with some of the AI & Computer Vision teams there on use cases such as robotics and automated visual inspection. Thought we could take advantage of the existing legal infrastructure to explore how we might collaborate with your specific team within Fraunhofer as well.

For context, sophisticated AI/ML teams like Fraunhofer, Baker Hughes and Philips usually come to us when they're at the point of scaling their model training & data pipelines. They mostly use Encord to improve their data curation / annotation and model evaluation processes to iterate on their AI models faster and/or reduce development costs. 

Could be great to chat and get your feedback on what we've built for some of the other Fraunhofer teams. Open to catch up this week? My Thursday's looking pretty open right now.

subject: Amazon to [COMPANY] | AI Data Quality
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I saw that a few senior automation / robotics execs (Kris, Devin, [SENDER], etc.) including yourself have moved over from Amazon to [COMPANY] in the last year - looks like the team is growing into new use cases (ex: cleaning robots with the OhmniLabs acquisition) on top of the traditional ones like palletization and box-picking. 

I'm actually working with most logistics robotics teams out there (Baker Hughes, Pickle Robot, RIOS Intelligent Machines, and Slamcore, etc.) and developing a few hypotheses around training data quality for AI models. 

I'd love to get your thoughts on these pieces and swap notes about what I've been seeing in the space. Would you be open to a quick virtual catch up this week or the next? My Wednesday's looking pretty open right now. 

Hope all's well and that you had a cozy holiday season,

subject: [YEAR] AI roadmap
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

I've been following [COMPANY] for some time & was curious to understand how you're thinking about AI model re-training to drive product improvements this year?

Given the complexities I imagine you're tracking across different glass manufacturing settings, thought it could be relevant to introduce how Encord can help you capture this complexity in your training data (& improve vs. basic annotation tooling).

Many of the CTOs / Heads of AI we work with were frustrated by the architectures of their existing annotation tooling (often CVAT or V7) limiting their ability to capture rich information from images / videos, as these labelling structures only support one level of depth.

We built Encord to support dynamic and nested labelling architecture of infinite depth, so you can build richer, and more insightful models, faster.

Open to learning more?
